title: SCA Minhag of the Week 165: "Tefilla BeSibbur: Se'uda Shelishit and Customs Before Arbit"

chapters.title: Customs of Se'uda Shelishit
chapters.about: Foods provided, transition from Minhah to Arbit, and the trend toward bread and Netilah.

chapters.title: The Alfabetta Custom
chapters.about: History of the Alfabetta, the Mahzor, and the sequence of Tehillim recited.

chapters.title: Nuances in Reciting the Alfabetta
chapters.about: Lehu Narenah, differences in printed editions like Kol Ya'akov, and skipped perakim due to time.

claims: "He describes the practice of reciting the Alfabetta from Tehillim and reviews the different customs and historical sources associated with it." - The teacher does not review historical sources in general, but specifically mentions the Mahzora Nosoba and the book Derech Eretz.
summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs of Se'uda Shelishit and the time between Minhah and Arbit in synagogues. He describes the practice of reciting the Alfabetta from Tehillim and reviews the different customs and historical sources associated with it.
questions: What are the customs for Se'uda Shelishit in the synagogue?
What did different groups in the synagogue do between Minhah and Arbit?
What is the Alfabetta and what does it include?
Which pesukim are recited before starting Tehillim in the Alfabetta?
Why are certain perakim skipped during the recitation of the Alfabetta?
